newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-E.Deakin says sells chemical units.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-E.Deakin says sells chemical units.

text.p: Heavy engineering group Evans Deaking Industries Ltd said on Monday it has entered into a contract with Asia Pacific Specialty Chemicals Ltd to sell its Industrial, Laboratory and Watercare businesses in Australia and New Zealand for A$21 million.
Evans Deakin said these businesses represented the largest remaining component of the chemical division following the sale of the Wolseley Castle business in December 1996.
The sale to Asia Pacific Specialty Chemicals would be effective on March 17, provided certain pre-conditions were met, Evans Deakin said.
Evans Deakin acquired the chemical operaitons as a consequence of its takeover of Clyde Industries last year and Evans Deakin said at that time that it would be sold.

"The sale will bring the total consideration of the sale of the chemical operations to A$47 million and will mean the greatest part of the assets invested in the chemicals business will have been sold," Evans Deakin chairman Ron Paul said in a statement.
Negotiations for the sale of the smaller specialty chemical operation were proceeding with interested parties, the company said.
Evans Deakin shares were five cents lower at A$3.60.
